description: This file contains tests and implementation for migrating boards in the focalboard project, including database setup, migration execution, and migration step management.

classes.name: BoardsMigrator
classes.description: A struct managing database migrations for boards, including setup, migration execution, and teardown.

methods.name: NewBoardsMigrator
methods.description: Constructor for BoardsMigrator, initializes with a flag for Mattermost migrations.

methods.name: runMattermostMigrations
methods.description: Executes Mattermost-specific database migrations using embedded assets.

methods.name: getDriver
methods.description: Returns the database driver instance based on the driver name.

methods.name: getMorphConnection
methods.description: Establishes and returns a morph engine and driver for migrations.

methods.name: Setup
methods.description: Prepares database connection, runs migrations if needed, and initializes the store and morph engine.

methods.name: MigrateToStep
methods.description: Applies migrations up to the specified step.

methods.name: Interceptors
methods.description: Returns migration interceptors, such as de-duplication migration.

methods.name: TearDown
methods.description: Closes the morph engine and database connection.

methods.name: DriverName
methods.description: Returns the name of the database driver.
